name: unsafe fn dealloc (ptr : * mut u8 , layout : Layout)
rule: For safety, `layout` must be the same layout that was used to allocate the block of memory pointed to by `ptr`.
api: unsafe fn dealloc (ptr : * mut u8 , layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout)
expression: No valid DSL expression exists for this requirement: the grammar exposes no comparable allocation-layout identity or numeric value for the opaque `$2.align`.
